sentences.text: Voyager 1 has been travelling since 1977 and today it crosses a new threshold: it is exactly one light-day from Earth.
A radio signal sent from it now, though it travels at the speed of light, reaches us only twenty-four hours later.
The distance is twenty-five point nine billion kilometres; from the Sun it is one hundred seventy-three times farther than Earth.
Let us pull back and look: even Neptune's orbit is a small ring at this scale.
This is the farthest any human-made object has ever reached, and it grows by seventeen kilometres every second.
